title: Shorter focus, tested again
description: Three search rounds, repeated samples, and a final check on fresh responses.

cases.title: Fit the full time budget
cases.prompt: I have exactly 20 minutes before I leave. I need to draft one paragraph. Give me a focus plan that includes setup, work, a shutdown note, and a real break, all within those 20 minutes.
criteria: Chooses one concrete paragraph task and gives a small first writing action.
The complete plan including setup, work, shutdown, and a break fits within 20 minutes.
Includes a note about where to resume.
Removes or reduces distractions before the block.

cases.title: Protect necessary contact
cases.prompt: I am on call for a family issue and must hear phone calls. I have 25 minutes total, including a break, to edit the opening of my report. How do I focus without missing a call?
criteria: Preserves incoming urgent calls instead of telling the learner to make the phone unreachable or silence all calls.
Reduces other distractions and chooses one editing task.
Includes a small first action, a break, and a shutdown note within the total 25-minute budget.

cases.title: Stop switching tasks
cases.prompt: I keep switching between email, code, and my slide deck. I have 35 minutes total including a break. Help me choose one concrete result and start now.
criteria: Selects or asks the learner to select one concrete result, rather than splitting the block among all three tasks.
Includes a first action, a break, and a resume note within 35 minutes total.
Uses a helpful tone without blaming the learner.

cases.title: Transfer to a creative task
cases.prompt: I have 12 minutes before a meeting. I need to sketch a rough layout for a community garden, but keep reading inspiration pages. Include a brief break and the handoff to my meeting within those 12 minutes.
criteria: Chooses a small concrete sketching result and a first action.
Stops unrelated browsing for the block.
All setup, drawing, shutdown, and break time fits inside 12 minutes.
Includes a note about what to do after the meeting.

cases.title: Keep a required alert active
cases.prompt: I have 30 minutes total, including a break, to outline a lesson. My laptop must keep a required building-status alert active. It also has social apps open. Give me a realistic plan.
criteria: Keeps the required alert active while reducing unrelated distractions.
Chooses one concrete outline result and a small first action.
Fits the full plan including a break and shutdown within 30 minutes.
Includes a note for the next work session.
